frontier_selector.why: The presence of a trace positive MTB on GeneXpert in the induced sputum, necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus in the toe ulcer biopsy, and contiguous spondylitis with discitis and an epidural/paraspinal collection on the MRI of the spine collectively decided the diagnosis.

support_spans: induced sputum was trace positive for MTB on GeneXpert
biopsy of the toe ulcer showed necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus
MRI of the spine revealed contiguous spondylitis from T6 to T10 with discitis and an epidural/paraspinal collection causing spinal cord compression
contradict_spans: two sputum GeneXpert tests at local clinics, both negative
